name: has_duplicates
doc: Return True if lst contains any duplicate element.

name: second_largest
doc: Return the second largest distinct value in lst.

name: flatten_once
doc: Flatten a list of lists one level deep.

name: intersection
sig: def intersection(a: list, b: list) -> list:
doc: Return unique elements present in both a and b.

name: is_anagram
sig: def is_anagram(s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
doc: Return True if s1 and s2 are anagrams (case-insensitive, ignore spaces).

name: longest_word
doc: Return the longest word in s; ties return the first.

name: multiply_all
doc: Return the product of all elements in lst (empty -> 1).

name: is_perfect_square
doc: Return True if n is a perfect square (n >= 0).

name: rotate_left
sig: def rotate_left(lst: list, k: int) -> list:
doc: Rotate lst left by k positions.

name: zip_sum
sig: def zip_sum(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
doc: Return element-wise sums of a and b (lengths are equal).

name: first_unique
doc: Return the first character in s that appears exactly once, or '' if none.

name: prefix_sum
doc: Return a list where result[i] is the sum of lst[0..i].

name: last_element
doc: Return the last element of lst (None if empty).

name: count_positives
doc: Return how many elements in lst are strictly positive.

name: merge_sorted
sig: def merge_sorted(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
doc: Merge two sorted lists into one sorted list.
